name: Partly cloudy on Saturday
source:
Returning home for summer vacation, Alex decides not to return to university in the fall. He stays in his hometown and decides to do what he has dreamed of for so long - perform a ritual to summon a demon who grants any wish. After making a deal with him, Alex will have five days to fully enjoy his request, after which he will have to pay the price...
